title: Contract Paralegal
description:
The Role

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a Contract Paralegal. This is a full-time, fixed-term contract for 3-6 months. The role is based in a Bristol office and is on-site.

You will manage fee-earning case work end to end and take responsibility for your own allocated matters, working within resourcing thresholds and under supervision. You will support case progression, client service, and financial accuracy while contributing to continuous improvement within the team.

Responsibilities will include
- Manage fee-earning end-to-end case work and take ownership of allocated matters under supervision.
- Prepare documentation and liaise with clients, customers, and third parties to progress cases within SLA.
- Draft correspondence and review incoming correspondence from third parties.
- Manage key dates and deadlines accurately.
- Update the Peppermint system to ensure data capture and MI reporting are accurate.
- Deliver excellent client service through effective case management.
- Manage matters financially with strong attention to billing and financial hygiene.
- Support continuous improvement and change initiatives within the team.
- Work within regulatory and industry frameworks, policies, and procedures.
- Maintain a positive culture and act as a role model within the team.

The Person

The successful candidate will be organised, accurate, and confident managing a busy caseload. You will have a strong client-service approach and the ability to work well under supervision while taking responsibility for your own matters.
- Experience in paralegal or fee-earning casework is desirable or a legal degree
- Strong written communication skills, including drafting correspondence.
- Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage deadlines, key dates, and financial processes.
- Confident using case management systems and working within set procedures.

The Hours

Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm

The Salary

£26,500.

The Contract:

3-6 months

The Location:

Central Bristol, no car parking

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal
- Annual Salary: To be discussed
- Location: Bristol
- Job Type: Hybrid (2 days in office)

We are seeking an experienced Personal Injury Case Handler to join our client's claimant injury department. The successful candidate will manage a diverse caseload involving a variety of injury claims, including those involving vulnerable road users and minor to moderate head injuries. This role requires a combination of office and home working, with 2 days per week spent in our clients Bristol office.

PLEASE NOTE: MUST HAVE LITIGATION/PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE AND BE ABLE TO CARRY A CASELOAD INDEPENDENTLY TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Efficiently and effectively manage your own caseload of personal injury claims.
- Pursue claims up to a value of £25,000.00 through and outside of the MOJ Portal, including pre and post litigation stages, making full use of our case management system.
- Comply fully with agreed service standards.
- Communicate with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, and solicitors.
- Attend and participate in weekly risk assessment meetings.
- Manage client expectations and effectively deal with any complaints that arise in line with company policy.
- Perform any other duties as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience handling a claimant injury caseload.
- Working knowledge of MOJ Portal processes.
- Experience pursuing claims allocated to the Fast Track.
- Experience of litigation including the issue of proceedings, complying with Court Directions through to Trial.
- Knowledge of a Case Management System.
- Ability to work to strict Service Level Agreements.
- Technical proficiency in claims handling including litigation.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to analyse and research legal issues.
- Ability to organise and prioritise work.
- Ability to work as part of a team.
- Law degree, CILEx, or equivalent qualification desirable but not essential.

Benefits:
- Excellent annual leave & welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan & gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Work-life balance & dress for your day.
- People-focused recognition & referral schemes.
- Development & routes to qualification.
- Diversity & sustainability initiatives.

A successful offer of employment is subject to a basic credit check and a basic DBS check.

We are committed to creating an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you encounter any barriers or need support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition & Resourcing team at

To apply for this Personal Injury Case Handler position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience.
